sun.name: Sun
sun.core: The drive to become someone: the hero's journey toward a coherent self — not who you are but who you are learning to be.
sun.shadow: Performing identity instead of forging it.
sun.arc: From seeking reflection to generating light.

moon.name: Moon
moon.core: The needing, remembering animal: what safety felt like before words, and what the body still reaches for under stress.
moon.shadow: Mistaking the familiar for the necessary.
moon.arc: From being had by needs to knowing and tending them.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.core: The messenger between worlds: how the mind perceives, names, connects, and trades.
mercury.shadow: Cleverness as armor; narrating life instead of living it.
mercury.arc: From collecting information to making meaning.

venus.name: Venus
venus.core: The valuer: what is beautiful, what is worth wanting, how one attracts and is attracted.
venus.shadow: Pleasing as a substitute for valuing oneself.

mars.name: Mars
mars.core: The will in the body: desire, anger, courage, the capacity to say no and to go get.
mars.arc: From reactive fire to directed force.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.core: The meaning-maker: the urge toward the larger picture — growth, faith, generosity, the intuition that life is going somewhere.
jupiter.shadow: Inflation; promising more than any life can deliver.
jupiter.arc: From appetite for more to trust in enough.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.core: The reality principle and the inner elder: limitation, time, mastery — the fear that guards the exact spot where authority must be earned.
saturn.shadow: The inner critic mistaken for the truth.
saturn.arc: From dread of the task to authorship of it.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.core: The awakener: the intolerance of the false, the lightning that breaks what has calcified.
uranus.shadow: Rebellion as reflex; freedom that never lands anywhere.
uranus.arc: From shock and rupture to authentic difference, lived calmly.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.core: The longing for the ocean: dissolution of boundaries, imagination, compassion, the ache for something this world doesn't quite provide.
neptune.shadow: Escape, fog, martyrdom, enchantment that will not survive daylight.
neptune.arc: From longing to leave the world to bringing the water back to it.

pluto.name: Pluto
pluto.core: The underworld: power, death-and-rebirth, the compost heap of the psyche where what is buried does not stay dead but transforms.
pluto.shadow: Control as a defense against powerlessness.
pluto.arc: From surviving to being remade — the phoenix, not the fortress.

chiron.name: Chiron
chiron.core: The wound that teaches: the place of injury that never fully closes and precisely thereby becomes the source of medicine for others.
chiron.arc: From ashamed patient to wounded healer.

north_node.name: North Node
north_node.core: The axis of becoming: the South Node is the well-worn room, the North Node the unfamiliar door the life keeps pointing toward.
north_node.shadow: Staying in competence that has become a hiding place.
north_node.arc: Direction, not character — departure lounge and destination.

aries.name: Aries
aries.core: Firstly, urgently, by igniting. The courage to begin; the innocence of the warrior.
aries.itch: Patience — what happens after the charge.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.core: Slowly, sensually, by rooting. Worth measured in what endures and can be touched.
taurus.itch: Letting go — security is not the same as stillness.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.core: Curiously, doubly, by connecting. Everything is interesting and everything has a twin.
gemini.itch: Depth — staying long enough for meaning to form.

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.core: Protectively, tidally, by feeling first. Memory and belonging as navigation.
cancer.itch: Exposure — letting the shell open from inside.

leo.name: Leo
leo.core: Radiantly, wholeheartedly, by creating. Life as self-expression; the heart wants witness.
leo.itch: Humility — shining without needing the mirror.

virgo.name: Virgo
virgo.core: Precisely, usefully, by refining. Devotion through craft; the sacred in the detail.
virgo.itch: Mercy — for the imperfect, especially oneself.

libra.name: Libra
libra.core: Harmoniously, relationally, by weighing. The self discovered through the other; beauty as justice.
libra.itch: Decision — choosing even when it costs the peace.

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.core: Intensely, totally, beneath the surface. Truth over comfort; intimacy as ordeal and reward.
scorpio.itch: Surrender — power shared rather than held.

sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sagittarius.core: Expansively, honestly, toward the horizon. Meaning is out there and the arrow is already flying.
sagittarius.itch: Presence — the horizon is also here.

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.core: Strategically, patiently, by climbing. Structure as devotion; the long game.
capricorn.itch: Tenderness — what the summit was for.

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.core: Independently, systemically, from the outside looking in. Loyalty to the future and to principle.
aquarius.itch: Belonging — joining the species one observes so well.

pisces.name: Pisces
pisces.core: Porously, compassionately, by dissolving. The boundary between self and world is thin — a gift and a tax.
pisces.itch: Form — banks that let the river actually flow somewhere.

conjunction.name: Conjunction
conjunction.core: Fusion: two characters standing in the same spot, sharing one costume; enormous power, little perspective.

opposition.name: Opposition
opposition.core: The negotiating table: two characters facing off across the axis, one often exiled into other people.
opposition.task: Withdraw the projection and hold both ends — the axis is one spine, not two enemies.

square.name: Square
square.core: Friction that builds engines: two characters at cross purposes, neither able to ignore the other.
square.task: Neither suppress nor alternate — engineer; let the tension torque something into motion.

trine.name: Trine
trine.core: Native ease: talent that feels so natural it may never be developed.
trine.task: Consciousness — spend the gift on purpose.

sextile.name: Sextile
sextile.core: The open invitation: compatibility that responds if approached.

quincunx.name: Quincunx
quincunx.core: The awkward adjustment: no shared language, obliged to share a life anyway.
